The formula for the derivative of $\text{arccsc}$ is

$$
\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\text{arccsc}\,x)=-\frac{1}{|x|\sqrt{{x}^{2}-1}}.
$$

Using the chain rule and the formula above, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}^{′}(x) & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(2arccsc(8-{x}^{4})) \\  & =2\cdot \frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(arccsc(8-{x}^{4})) \\  & =2(-\frac{1}{|8-{x}^{4}|\sqrt{(8-{x}^{4})^{2}-1}})\cdot \frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(8-{x}^{4}) \\  & =2(-\frac{1}{|8-{x}^{4}|\sqrt{(8-{x}^{4})^{2}-1}})\cdot (-4{x}^{3}) \\  & =\frac{8{x}^{3}}{|8-{x}^{4}|\sqrt{(8-{x}^{4})^{2}-1}}.\end{aligned}
$$
